description: Manage the checks that should be run on a machine by Sensu.

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Classifies the check as an aggregate check, making it available using the aggregate API. Default is false. Choices: false true

parameters.name: backup
parameters.description: Create a backup file (if yes), including the timestamp information so you can get the original file back if you somehow clobbered it incorrectly. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Path to the sensu check to run (not required when state=absent).

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: A hash/dictionary of custom parameters for mixing to the configuration. You cannot rewrite other module parameters using this.

parameters.name: dependencies
parameters.description: Other checks this one depends on. If dependencies fail handling of this check is disabled.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Whether the check should be handled or not. Default is false. Choices: false true

parameters.name: handlers
parameters.description: List of handlers to notify when the check fails.

parameters.name: high_flap_threshold
parameters.description: The high threshold for flap detection.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Check interval in seconds.

parameters.name: low_flap_threshold
parameters.description: The low threshold for flap detection.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Whether the check is a metric. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the check. This is the key that is used to determine whether a check exists.

parameters.name: occurrences
parameters.description: Number of event occurrences before the handler should take action. If not specified, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the JSON file of the check to be added/removed. It is created if it does not exist (unless state=absent). The parent folders need to exist when state=present, otherwise an error is thrown. Default: "/etc/sensu/conf.d/checks.json"

parameters.name: publish
parameters.description: Whether the check should be scheduled at all. You can still issue it using the sensu API. Default is false. Choices: false true

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Number of seconds handlers should wait before taking second action.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The check source, used to create a JIT Sensu client for an external resource (for example a network switch).

parameters.name: standalone
parameters.description: Whether the check should be scheduled by the sensu client or server. This option obviates the need for specifying the subscribers option. Default is false. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the check should be present or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: subdue_begin
parameters.description: When to disable handling of check failures.

parameters.name: subdue_end
parameters.description: When to enable handling of check failures.

parameters.name: subscribers
parameters.description: List of subscribers/channels this check should run for. See sensu_subscribers to subscribe a machine to a channel.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for the check. If not specified, it defaults to 10.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time to live in seconds until the check is considered stale.

examples:
# Fetch metrics about the CPU load every 60 seconds,
# the sensu server has a handler called 'relay' which forwards stats to graphite
- name: Get cpu metrics
  community.general.sensu_check:
    name: cpu_load
    command: /etc/sensu/plugins/system/cpu-mpstat-metrics.rb
    metric: true
    handlers: relay
    subscribers: common
    interval: 60

# Check whether nginx is running
- name: Check nginx process
  community.general.sensu_check:
    name: nginx_running
    command: /etc/sensu/plugins/processes/check-procs.rb -f /var/run/nginx.pid
    handlers: default
    subscribers: nginx
    interval: 60

# Stop monitoring the disk capacity.
# Note that the check will still show up in the sensu dashboard,
# to remove it completely you need to issue a DELETE request to the sensu api.
- name: Check disk
  community.general.sensu_check:
    name: check_disk_capacity
    state: absent
